subject.title: fix(auto-reply): hide recovered failed tool progress

question: Should regular verbose mode hide failed tool progress after a confirmed visible non-error reply, changing the current default that tool-error warnings are shown unless explicitly suppressed?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but current documentation exposes warnings by default and the canonical issue has not resolved default behavior versus an explicit policy.

options.title: Keep current default
options.body: Close this PR and retain visible tool-error warnings unless the operator uses the existing suppression setting.

options.title: Sponsor recovery-aware hiding
options.body: Approve the new shared default, then reopen or refresh this implementation with documentation and exact-head channel validation.

options.title: Design explicit policy
options.body: Preserve the current default and add a setting only if maintainers accept the additional configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Keep current default
recommendation.body: Close this PR and retain visible tool-error warnings unless the operator uses the existing suppression setting.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history across both shared delivery files and is best positioned to decide the cross-channel default.
